title: LA Day Trip to Casinos, Palm Springs, San Diego, Santa Barbara
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You don't have to be a tourist to enjoy a comfortable and luxurious ride with a state-certified professional driver to your destination of choice. LA's transportation options are very limited, so let Tallawah Limousine & Tours take you out of LA for the day, your choice! Santa Barbara or a relaxing day at a Palm Springs spa are the 2 favorites. We also visit the popular casinos just outside of LA such as Yaamava, Agua Caliente, Pachanga, and Morongo. Or maybe you're in a beachy mood - La Jolla and San Diego seem to do the trick. Ask us about a destination of your choosing.
